page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE REGISTRY No. S. B. D. 8672 Date 1-6-42）
Station. File No.____________________ Date May 22, 1942

SUBJECT: G.A. Atlasoff.

With reference to the attached letter dated
May 18, 1942 in which a certain A.ATLASOFF informs the
Shanghai Municipal Council of the appearance of his pub-
lication entitled "MY OBSERVATIONS" ( copy attached ),
I have to state that this individual forms the subject
of criminal record the particulars of which are as fol-
lows:-

Charge Sentence Date
Larceny 2 months imprison- 19-12-28
ment
Shoplifting 3 months imprison- 25-2-30
(2 counts) ment
Larceny 30 days imprison- 14-11-36
ment

He also is mentioned in File D-4842 in connection
with fraudulent activities of a certain bogus charity or-
ganization ( now extinct ), on behalf of which he collected
donations in Shanghai and other cities in the Far East.
For the past several years he is known to have been pub-
lishing from time to time various worthless pamphlets of
a "scientific and commercial" character for the purpose
of commercial advertising.

His application for registration of his periodi-
cal entitled " Travelling Advertising in the Far East"
was turned down by the Municipal Police on account of
his antecedents ( vide file D-8672).

Attached pamphlet contains nothing of an objecti-
nable nature .

（印：INDEX (S.B.) REGISTRY 116/42）

Officer i/Charge Foreign Section,
Special Branch

G. Prokopieff
D.I.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处档案室编号 S. B. D. 8672 日期 1942年6月1日）
警署。档案号___ 日期 1942年5月22日

事由：G.A. Atlasoff。

关于所附1942年5月18日的信件，信中某位 A. ATLASOFF 通知上海公共租界工部局，其名为《我的观察》（MY OBSERVATIONS）的出版物已问世（副本附后），本人须声明，此人有犯罪记录，详情如下：-

指控 判决 日期
盗窃罪 监禁2个月 1928年12月19日
商店行窃 监禁3个月 1930年2月25日
（两项指控）
盗窃罪 监禁30天 1936年11月14日

他在档案 D-4842 中也被提及，涉及某个虚假慈善组织（现已不存在）的欺诈活动，他曾代表该组织在上海及远东其他城市募集捐款。众所周知，在过去几年里，他不时出版各种毫无价值的“科学与商业”性质的小册子，目的是进行商业广告宣传。

他申请注册其名为《远东旅行广告》的期刊，因其过往经历被警务处驳回（参见档案 D-8672）。

所附小册子不包含任何令人反感的内容。

（印：索引 (S.B.) 档案室 116/42）

特科外籍股主管警官

G. Prokopieff
巡官

MY OBSERVATIONS.
- SECOND SERIES -

此風景即阿特拉索夫
遊察於全世界之一也

A. Atlasoff on his voyage
in the
Far East.

PERTURBATION IN THE WHOLE WORLD.

1. There is no one able to predict what awaits people in the future.
2. Peoples' lives, their property and capital at the present times are not safe.
3. Life may become so, that money will be unable to buy anything. Out of gold and platinum dishes will be made, out of gold and other precious stones ordinary trimmings for dresses, bread and other products will be given for work.
4. At the present times there are some people who think one way, talk the other way and do things quite the contrary.
This is an enigmatic act, which darkens the truth, and hinders honest thinkings and impediments good actions.

A. Atlasoff.

1
page_data.zh:
《我的观察》。
- 第二系列 -

此风景即阿特拉索夫
游察于全世界之一也

A. Atlasoff 在
远东的航行中。

全世界的动荡。

1. 没有人能够预测未来等待着人们的是什么。
2. 目前，人们的生命、财产和资本都不安全。
3. 生活可能会变成这样：金钱将无法买到任何东西。金和铂将被制成餐具，金和其他宝石将被制成普通的服装饰物，面包和其他产品将作为工作的报酬给予。
4. 目前有些人心里想的一套，嘴上说的另一套，做的却完全相反。
这是一种神秘的行为，它掩盖了真相，阻碍诚实的思考并妨碍良好的行动。

A. Atlasoff。

1

page_data.en:
Poverty.

Life has become very difficult lately and every human
being battles as long as possible against hunger
and death. All these poor people lose friends and sympathy
towards them, and often some of their wealthy relatives
become hard, ununderstanding and unwilling to help. At such
circumstances they lose every hope in improvement, they
find themselves more miserable than they are, and very
unsuccessful in everything they undertake and it becomes
harder for them to fight with the fate. There exists for
them only one cathegory of people the kind and helpful
people, understanding without words the hard life of the
poor. And yet many of them leave this world for the
other from exhaustion and much worries before time, who
under more favourable living conditions could prolong
their lives, and probably most of them would do useful
things in this world.

A. Atlasoff.

A. ATLASOFF DURING HIS VISIT TO
THE IMPERIAL ALLEYS, NANKING.

2.
page_data.zh:
贫困。

最近生活变得非常艰难，每个人都在尽可能长地与饥饿和死亡作斗争。所有这些穷人都失去了朋友和同情，甚至他们的一些富裕亲戚也变得冷酷、不理解且不愿提供帮助。在这种情况下，他们对改善状况失去了一切希望，觉得自己比实际处境更加悲惨，在他们从事的一切事情中都非常不成功，与命运抗争变得更加困难。对他们来说，只有一类人存在，那就是善良和乐于助人的人，他们无需言语就能理解穷人的艰难生活。然而，他们中的许多人因疲惫和过多的忧虑而早逝，如果在更有利的生活条件下，他们本可以延长寿命，而且他们中的大多数人可能会在这个世界上做一些有益的事情。

A. Atlasoff。

A. ATLASOFF 在访问
南京御道期间。

2.

«SEE CENTRE PICTURE THE LIVING BUDDHA»
nce praying for six months on his knees in the high
mountains of China, refusing all food and keeping up life by
taking only fruits in small quantities.
The Chinese Society of Charity „Moral“ is composed of over
sixty thousand people helping the poor with all most necessary
things as: food, clothes, money, medicines, etc. This Society
helps daily over ten thousand poor people in many Chinese cities.

中国慈善团体“道德”社由六万多人组成，向穷人提供所有最必要的物品，如：食物、衣物、金钱、药品等。该社每天在中国许多城市帮助一万多名穷人。

CLAIM.

Dear Sirs,

I am willing to open an office to accept advertisements

on the Settlement.

the Chinese National Government for editing the books
under the name of "Travelling Advertising in the Far East".

edited now.

I am thanking you in advance, hoping you will not
refuse to my demand.
